title: SkillsLibrary
description: A folia-compatible library for allowing users to create abilities
body:
SkillsLibrary is a shared core library used to power custom abilities across several Minecraft plugins, including Superheroes, EnchantedBosses, EnchantedCombat, and SuperheroesPlusUltra. It exists to make complex skills consistent, reliable, and reusable across different gameplay systems.

For players, this means abilities behave predictably and interact cleanly with combat, mobs, and other mechanics. Skills such as superhero powers, boss attacks, and combat effects are built on the same underlying system, so they follow the same rules for targeting, cooldowns, scaling, and activation. 

SkillsLibrary allows skills to react to real gameplay events like attacking, taking damage, using abilities, or meeting specific conditions. Skills can apply effects such as damage, knockback, potion effects, movement changes, or temporary modifiers, all while respecting cooldowns and limits defined by the server. Because skills are modular, more advanced abilities can be created by combining simpler behaviours, enabling things like chained attacks, conditional effects, or abilities that evolve over time.

Performance is another key benefit. SkillsLibrary is designed to run efficiently in real-time combat situations, even on busy servers with many players and entities. Abilities trigger quickly and cleanly without adding unnecessary overhead. It even supports Folia!

Overall, SkillsLibrary provides the foundation that makes advanced abilities possible across multiple plugins, resulting in smoother gameplay, better balance, and a more polished experience for players.
